rationale: The agent initiated an exchange without first confirming the specific replacements or any potential charges with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. While the agent appears to have attempted authentication (lookup by name and ZIP, then user details) and accessed an order, there is no explicit confirmation that the order belonged to the user. More critically, the agent did not present candidate items for the coffee machine that preserve capacity/type while adjusting pressure (8 bar preferred, else 9, else 7, else no exchange), nor did it verify that the chosen replacement met those constraints. Similarly, it did not demonstrate finding the cheapest i7-or-above laptop before executing the exchange. The tool call to perform the exchange with a gift card payment method was executed without user confirmation of items or any price difference, and without confirming fallback to credit card if the gift card were not possible. The final message states the exchange is in process, indicating a write occurred without prior confirmation. These issues fail the pass bar.
